disclaimer: Pathways are optional learning sequences, not public missions, eligibility checks or validated community priorities.

pathways.name: Understand living systems
pathways.learning_goal: Explore watersheds and ecological relationships before designing habitat concepts.
pathways.non_goal: No planting, wildlife intervention or land modification is authorized.

pathways.name: Build for different ways of participating
pathways.learning_goal: Practice inclusive design without diagnosing or speaking for others.
pathways.non_goal: A simulated workshop does not establish community consent or accessibility compliance.

pathways.name: Keep useful materials in circulation
pathways.learning_goal: Compare repair/reuse options and design a safe fictional sharing system.
pathways.non_goal: No hazardous repairs, unauthorized lending or claims of lifecycle impact.

pathways.name: Waste prevention without compromising safety
pathways.learning_goal: Learn food safety constraints and calculate an explicitly fictional baseline.
pathways.non_goal: No food service changes, donation decisions, or measured real-world waste prevention.

pathways.name: Understand public decisions
pathways.learning_goal: Read official sources and prepare neutral, accessible public-service guides.
pathways.non_goal: No official endorsement, targeted persuasion or corruption allegations.

pathways.name: Improve systems, not enemies
pathways.learning_goal: Compare voluntary change, oversight and lawful alternatives using fictional institutions.
pathways.non_goal: No covert infiltration, pressure campaigns, institutional certification, or real-world compact.

pathways.name: Begin where strengths already exist
pathways.learning_goal: Notice existing supports and prepare respectful accessibility ideas.
pathways.non_goal: Do not assess or identify individual residents or claim representation.

pathways.name: Learn repair through safer decisions
pathways.learning_goal: Explore safer repair decisions and consent-based group planning.
pathways.non_goal: No high-risk repairs or group events without actual safety capacity.

pathways.name: Plan evidence before acting
pathways.learning_goal: Understand consent, baseline measurement, and burdens on workers.
pathways.non_goal: No workplace data collection without independent consent and site approval.

pathways.name: Make civic processes understandable
pathways.learning_goal: Create accurate summaries and practice non-deceptive accountability language.
pathways.non_goal: No political profiling or unsolicited influence directed at named individuals.
